new_libraries.name: ProtoCentral HealthyPi 5
new_libraries.author: ProtoCentral Electronics
new_libraries.sentence: Dual-core NEXT runtime and board support for the ProtoCentral HealthyPi 5 (RP2040).
new_libraries.paragraph: Encapsulates the production HealthyPi 5 NEXT dual-core AMP architecture for the arduino-pico core: core1 does lossless 128 SPS acquisition (MAX30001 + AFE4400) into a lock-free ring while core0 runs a broker, per-sink queues, a built-in OpenView 2 streamer, 1 Hz telemetry and a hardware watchdog. Includes board.h, the canonical pin map for HealthyPi 5 revisions 5.2-5.7, and auto-detects the on-board temperature sensor (MAX30205 or AS6221). Requires the arduino-pico FreeRTOS variant (include <FreeRTOS.h> in the sketch).
depends: ProtoCentral AFE4490 PPG and SpO2 boards library

library.name: WCB_Client
library.author: Greg Hulette
library.sentence: Client library for joining a Wireless Communication Board (WCB) ESP-NOW network.
library.paragraph: Allows any ESP32-based device to participate as a native peer in a WCB network. Supports unicast and broadcast text commands with automatic fragmentation for long commands (e.g. saving large stored sequences), raw binary forwarding for Pololu/Maestro servo packets via WCBStream, ETM heartbeat and ACK tracking, board online/offline status callbacks, and communication with an out-of-band special peer such as NaviCore via enableSpecialPeer(). A raw-packet hook (onRawPacket/sendRawPacket) lets custom protocols — such as firmware OTA — ride the same ESP-NOW mesh. setIdentity() advertises the device over WDP so WCBs discover it by name and firmware version automatically (the mesh twin of the serial WDP-DA device-announce model), and onNeighbor()/getNeighbor() consume the same WDP adverts to learn every WCB and client on the mesh — alias, firmware, capabilities, controller link and Maestro IDs.
